workflows.name: matrix_and_dataframe
workflows.intent: Filter high-throughput sequencing data in the form of a raw count matrix or data.frame using TMM normalization.
input: counts_matrix.csv (raw count matrix where rows are features and columns are samples)
sample_metadata.csv (phenotype table containing sample condition labels)
workflows.stages: 1. Extract the expression matrix and condition labels ;; 2. Run HTSFilter to find the optimal threshold and filter the matrix ;; 3. Extract the filtered and removed data matrices.
workflows.code:
mat <- exprs(sultan)
conds <- as.character(pData(sultan)$cell.line)

## Only 25 tested thresholds to reduce computation time
filter <- HTSFilter(mat, conds, s.min=1, s.max=200, s.len=25)
mat <- filter$filteredData
dim(mat)
dim(filter$removedData)

workflows.name: edger_pipeline
workflows.intent: Filter edgeR differential expression results (DGEExact or DGELRT objects) using HTSFilter.
input: sample_metadata.csv (phenotype table containing sample condition labels)
workflows.stages: 1. Create a DGEList and calculate normalization factors ;; 2. Estimate dispersions and perform exact test (for DGEExact) or fit a GLM and perform a likelihood ratio test (for DGELRT) ;; 3. Apply HTSFilter to the exact test or LRT results ;; 4. Extract top tags from the filtered object.
workflows.code:
dge <- DGEList(counts=exprs(sultan), group=conds)
dge <- calcNormFactors(dge)
dge <- estimateDisp(dge)
et <- exactTest(dge)
et <- HTSFilter(et, DGEList=dge, s.len=25, plot=FALSE)$filteredData
dim(et)
class(et)
topTags(et)

design <- model.matrix(~conds)
dge <- DGEList(counts=exprs(sultan), group=conds)
dge <- calcNormFactors(dge)
dge <- estimateDisp(dge, design)
fit <- glmFit(dge,design)
lrt <- glmLRT(fit,coef=2)
lrt <- HTSFilter(lrt, DGEGLM=fit, s.len=25, plot=FALSE)$filteredData
dim(lrt)
class(lrt)
topTags(lrt)

workflows.name: deseq2_pipeline
workflows.intent: Filter a DESeqDataSet object within the DESeq2 pipeline and perform differential analysis with independent filtering disabled in DESeq2.
input: sample_metadata.csv (phenotype table containing sample condition labels)
workflows.stages: 1. Create a DESeqDataSet from the count matrix ;; 2. Run DESeq differential analysis ;; 3. Filter the DESeqDataSet using HTSFilter ;; 4. Extract results with independentFiltering=FALSE.
workflows.code:
conds <- gsub(" ", ".", conds)
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = exprs(sultan),
                              colData = data.frame(cell.line = factor(conds)),
                              design = ~ cell.line)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
filter <- HTSFilter(dds, s.len=25, plot=FALSE)$filteredData
class(filter)
dim(filter)
res <- results(filter, independentFiltering=FALSE)
head(res)

workflows.name: external_normalization
workflows.intent: Filter count data that has been normalized using an external method (e.g., EDASeq full quantile normalization) by setting norm="none".
input: sample_metadata.csv (phenotype table containing sample condition labels)
workflows.stages: 1. Create a SeqExpressionSet and normalize using EDASeq betweenLaneNormalization ;; 2. Apply HTSFilter with norm="none" ;; 3. Identify filtered and unfiltered genes using the "on" vector.
workflows.code:
library(EDASeq)
ses <- newSeqExpressionSet(exprs(sultan),
       phenoData=pData(sultan))
ses.norm <- betweenLaneNormalization(ses, which="full")
filter <- HTSFilter(counts(ses.norm), conds, s.len=25, norm="none",
          plot=FALSE)
head(filter$on)
table(filter$on)
